name: Two-stage CBR Method for Transfer Function Design
definition: A method to automatically generate transfer functions (TFs) for volume rendering by retrieving similar cases from a knowledge database based on a user-selected ray's image and intensity profile features, then optimizing the retrieved TF for visibility.
summary: The Two-stage CBR Method automatically designs transfer functions by first matching co-planar images with CNNs and then re-ranking via intensity profile alignment to prevent misclassification.
